say:2:1721934002:1.text: I remember one rainy day when I was playing in the street. I was performing one of my sad pieces, and everyone just kept walking past.
say:2:1721934002:1.source_cn: 记得有那么一次，我在街头卖艺。那天下着雨，我又弹得太悲...
say:2:1721934002:1.male: I remember one rainy day when I was playing in the street. I was performing one of my sad pieces, and everyone just kept walking past.
say:2:1721934002:1.female: I remember one rainy day when I was playing in the street. I was performing one of my sad pieces, and everyone just kept walking past.

say:3:1721934003:1.text: But one little girl stayed until the end. Then she ran over and pressed a candy like this into my hand.
say:3:1721934003:1.source_cn: 只有一个小女孩听完后跑过来，塞给了我一颗这样的水果糖。
say:3:1721934003:1.male: But one little girl stayed until the end. Then she ran over and pressed a candy like this into my hand.
say:3:1721934003:1.female: But one little girl stayed until the end. Then she ran over and pressed a candy like this into my hand.

say:4:1721934004:1.text: She said, "Here. Something sweet might cheer you up." It was the first time I felt like my music had earned me kindness instead of ridicule.
say:4:1721934004:1.source_cn: 她说，大哥哥，吃了糖就不苦了。那是我第一次感觉到，原来...
say:4:1721934004:1.male: She said, "Here. Something sweet might cheer you up." It was the first time I felt like my music had earned me kindness instead of ridicule.
say:4:1721934004:1.female: She said, "Here. Something sweet might cheer you up." It was the first time I felt like my music had earned me kindness instead of ridicule.

say:6:1721934005:1.text: I still remember how sweet that candy tasted... Ma'am, I'll take one. The sweetest one you have!
say:6:1721934005:1.source_cn: 那颗糖的甜味我到现在都还记得……老板，请给我一颗水果糖...

say:8:1721934006:1.text: You got it! I'll pick out a big one. Life needs a little sweetness!
say:8:1721934006:1.source_cn: 好嘞！给您挑颗最大的！生活嘛，总得有点甜头才行！

choice:5:1:2.text: Miss Pearl might like that memory.
